rewrites.comment: The docs site is a single-page app with 27 client-side routes. Without this, opening /components/phone-input directly — or refreshing it — is a 404, because no such file exists on disk. Vercel checks the filesystem first, so /r/*.json and /llms.txt are still served as real files and are NOT swallowed by this catch-all.

headers.comment: The registry is fetched by `npx shadcn add` from the user's terminal, which is a different origin. Without CORS the install fails.
Hashed filenames, so these can be cached forever.
